{{Top|leg}}

'''Khipu''', also known as '''talking knots''', were knotted strings that recorded data. The knots on a khipu could be tied in over six million unique knots with each one reading as specific deformation of a circle in a three-dimensional space. Any [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with a basic [[Analytical computer/Legends|analytical drive]] could unravel each knot's linking integral to translate the khipu into letters or numbers. The elusive [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] [[Arms dealer/Legends|dealer]] [[Iram Radique]] that operated out of the [[Cog Hive Seven]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] paid his [[Prisoner/Legends|inmate]] associates with polymer filaments tied into khipus. Each khipu could be translated into a twenty-one digit number. The first twelve digits made up an ID reference for an [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|IGBC]] account on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], the last nine were the account's password.

==Behind the scenes==
Khipus are directly inspired by the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quipu quipu] recording system used by the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Andean_civilizations Inca] and other cultures of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_Andean_South_America Andean South America]. While ''quipu'' is the most common spelling used in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spanish_language Spanish] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/English_language English], ''khipu'' is one of the spelling variations used in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quechuan_languages Quechua].
